title: It's just a matter of time (and money) until NFL uniforms have ads

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: It's just a matter of time (and money) until NFL uniforms have ads
sources.description: The NFL probably wishes that, from the moment the founders of the league gathered at a Hupmobile Dealership, they had made the standard football uniform look like NASCAR overalls.
